parameters.label: Model
parameters.errorMessage: Please select a valid Inworld TTS model.

parameters.label: Voice
parameters.helpText: Each voice is tied to a specific language — the voice's language is shown in its name.
parameters.errorMessage: Please select a valid Inworld voice.

parameters.label: Speaking Rate
parameters.helpText: Speaking speed. 1.0 is natural speed. Values below 0.8 may reduce quality.

parameters.label: Sample Rate (Hz)
parameters.helpText: Synthesis sample rate. If different from the voice's natural rate, audio will be resampled.

parameters.label: Temperature
parameters.helpText: Controls randomness of audio token sampling. Higher values are more expressive; lower values are more deterministic.

parameters.label: Text Normalization
parameters.helpText: Expands numbers, dates, and abbreviations before synthesis. Disabling may reduce latency.
